subject: english
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: The cursor must be plased at the strat of the line.
The cursor must be placed at the start of the line.
The cursor must be plased at the start of the line.
The cursur must be placed at the start of the line.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The cursor must be placed at the start of the line:** This sentence is **spelled correctly.** Every word is written as it should be.
 
• **The cursor must be plased at the strat of the line: **This sentence contains **two spelling errors**. "Plased" should be "placed" and "strat" should be "start".
 
• **The cursor must be plased at the start of the line: **This sentence contains **one spelling error**. "Plased" should be "placed".
 
• **The cursur must be placed at the start of the line:** This sentence contains **one spelling error.** "Cursur" should be "cursor".

Therefore, the sentence with** no spelling error** is: *"The cursor must be placed at the start of the line".*
